column1: # The first-line rule catalogue, in ADR 0004 order and as its machine form.
# stays authoritative for the prose; this file is what the code reads.
# One rule per line, six tab-separated fields, no tabs or newlines inside a
# field. A malformed line fails loudly when the catalogue is first read.

column3: summary
column4: fix
column6: refer-when

column1: # class is one of FIX (one PR, CI configuration only), ACT (a first-line action
# with no code change), REFER (referral to Hypatia), OWNER (only the owner may
# act; the squabbler reports) or NOISE (not a defect; the squabbler labels it).
# "(owner)" stands in for check and refer-when on an OWNER row.
# A new rule is added here and to ADR 0004 together, and the class counts in
# the catalogue_shape test are updated with it.

column3: invalid lockfile pin: an actions.lock record keyed owner/repo@<40-hex> repeats that SHA as its ref
column4: Refresh scripts/check-lock-sync.sh from template main, then set each flagged ref to the highest full-semver tag at the SHA, else highest semver tag, else first tag, else a branch containing the commit
column5: The template lock-sync gate exits 0 and the failed workflow no longer reports invalid lockfile pin; scripts/check-lock-sync.sh needs GNU awk and mikefarah yq v4, and a missing tool means the check did not run, never a pass
column6: No tag or branch holds the SHA; tags tie; the lock also lacks entries

column3: lockfile missing pin for an action called inside another action; or lockfile verification did not produce a result because a locked ref no longer resolves (unable to find version <sha>); or refs missing from the lockfile (check-lock-sync.sh: FAIL <workflow>: refs missing from the lockfile: <action>@<sha>); or a workflow bumped an action past its lock (stale lock, found statically)
column4: Regenerate the lock with gh actions-lock
column5: The lock-sync gate passes and the job starts
column6: The regenerated lock disagrees with the workflow YAML, or the missing ref is an action called inside a reusable workflow that gh actions-lock has not been shown to regenerate (this-ssg release.yml slsa-github-generator@f7dd8c54, run 43156768667)

column3: reusable-calling workflow ends with zero jobs; the lock records the callee's old owner_id after a transfer
column4: Repoint uses: to the canonical owner/name at a standards commit whose allowlist already covers metadatastician/standards/.github/workflows/*@* (8d1a2aa or later; governance / Allowlist Preflight reads the allowlist at the pinned commit), and relock with scripts/relock-standards-pin.sh from standards main
column5: Each record's owner_id equals the repository API owner id; the next run has jobs; check-allowed-actions.sh <allowlist at target> .github/workflows reports 0 gaps
column6: The pinned SHA is not reachable from the callee's default branch, or the callee is outside the estate, or no standards commit with that allowlist pattern is also free of pin-contract violations for the repository

column3: a pinned reusable ends startup_failure on every push while a newer audited SHA runs green elsewhere
column4: Repin to the newest audited green SHA and update the closure rows and pinned-reusable-sources.json together
column5: The next push run has jobs
column6: No audited closure row exists for the target SHA, or the new SHA declares more secrets

column3: the DEED lane fails unrecognised #-form on a literal the current ABNF admits: the repository pins an old standards SHA
column4: Bump every standards pin site in .github/workflows and scripts to one current SHA
column5: No pin site keeps the old SHA and validate-deed.sh passes at the new pin
column6: The newer linter rejects existing deed content; deed meaning is never edited

column3: setup-bun fails on the GitHub API rate limit, or a setup-bun step has no exact bun-version
column4: Set bun-version to the estate pin 1.4.2
column6: The repository pins another Bun on purpose, or the step is in a third-party, forked or vendored workflow

column3: cargo install --git of the old panic-attacker name with no pin in a workflow
column4: Use hyperpolymath/panic-attack at the pin in gitbot-fleet bots/panicbot/canon/pin.toml
column6: The name maps to more than one repository

column3: a workflow whose job is a cross-repository uses: <owner>/<repo>/.github/workflows/<x>.yml@<sha> ends failure or startup_failure with zero jobs on every push
column4: Replace the caller with the inline-job form that rsr-template-repo main uses for the same workflow (it runs the gates from the pinned SHA without a cross-repository workflow_call) and keep actions.lock in sync
column5: The next push run is success with more than 0 jobs and the lock-sync gate passes
column6: The template has no inline form for that workflow, a required context name would change, the repository customised the caller on purpose, or the inline form still gives 0 jobs

column3: different nickel or yq versions across CI, Containerfile, mise and setup scripts
column4: One version everywhere, sha256-pinned (Nickel 1.18.0; yq v4.53.3)
column5: One version found; the installer verifies the sha256
column6: No upstream checksums exist (state trust-on-first-download, never verified)

column3: Dependabot fails with Dependabot detected that Bun is misconfigured ... This project has a bun.lock file but no package-lock.json, yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml (type misconfigured_tooling, tool Bun): a dependabot.yml entry uses package-ecosystem npm for a directory that bun manages
column4: In .github/dependabot.yml change package-ecosystem from npm to bun for that directory only, and correct any comment that says npm supports bun.lock; leave every other entry and its schedule, limits, groups and ignores unchanged
column5: The next Dependabot run for that directory finishes without a misconfigured_tooling error
column6: The directory holds a second lockfile (bun.lock plus another), or the repository has no matching Dependabot ecosystem

column3: estate-rules reports the committed REPOSITORY-MAP.adoc is stale
column4: Run bash scripts/gen-repo-map.sh . and commit the map
column6: The map still differs after regeneration

column3: a deed or k9 line is over 998 octets (K9-E006)
column4: Wrap the string or description, layout only
column6: A wrap would change a value (identifier, hash, URL)

column3: a job with if: always() and needs: that downloads an artifact (actions/download-artifact without run-id) runs after a cancelled run and fails on the missing artifact (Hypatia WF029)
column4: Change the job condition to ${{ !cancelled() }}
column5: The workflow is valid YAML, the job still runs after failed or skipped needs, and it does not run in a cancelled run
column6: The job must run after cancellation on purpose, or the workflow is vendored or third-party

column3: kyaml-format: <file> is not KYAML (quintessence run 43156792336: build/container/compose.yaml)
column4: Run scripts/kyaml-format.sh <file> and commit the layout change. The generator is named here and is never taken from the log; it needs mikefarah Go yq (Python yq corrupts the file)
column5: The output is KYAML and the repository kyaml check passes; a missing yq means the check did not run, never a pass
column6: The output is not KYAML, the formatter changes a value, or yq is not the mikefarah Go build

column3: an instance's canon-lockstep job is an old inline copy and goes red on a canon release
column4: Run rsr-template-repo scripts/adopt-canon-lockstep.sh
column5: The canon-lockstep job passes with the lag notice
column6: The script refuses (lock coverage), or the pin itself must change (A2ML is never edited automatically)

column3: Resource not accessible by integration at get-a-workflow-run in a job that uploads SARIF on a private repository
column4: Add actions: read to that job's permissions, with a comment that names the reason
column5: The upload step passes on a re-run
column6: The permission is already present, or the repository is public

column3: a setup or download step fails with API rate limit exceeded and the same workflow passes on an adjacent commit
column4: Re-run the failed jobs once after the rate-limit reset, only if that commit is still the head
column6: It fails twice on the same commit, the log has no rate-limit text, or the step is not a setup or download step

column3: a PR is blocked with required checks green under a strict ruleset and its base is behind the default branch
column4: Update the branch by merging the base; never rebase a branch the squabbler did not open
column5: The required checks pass on the new head
column6: Merge conflict, or still blocked on an up-to-date head

column3: a step fails on a transient host or API error: gh: HTTP 5xx, gh: Server Error (HTTP 5xx), a git remote returning 5xx, or Could not resolve host or Failed to connect to a host name that contains a dot
column4: Re-run the failed job once, only if that commit is still the head
column6: It fails twice on the same commit, the status is 401 or 403 (a token problem: SQ-OWN-09, or a rate limit: SQ-RUN-01), or the host name has no dot (a service container or localhost is a configuration error a re-run cannot fix)

column3: gitleaks fails with fatal: ambiguous argument <sha>^..<sha>: unknown revision or path not in the working tree, because a shallow checkout lacks the range base commit; trufflehog reports commits: 0 for the same range
column4: Re-run the failed job once, only if that commit is still the head
column5: The re-run passes and the scan covers more than 0 commits
column6: It fails twice on the same commit: refer with the suggestion fetch-depth: 0 on the scan checkout

column3: a step fails with Could not resolve host or Failed to connect to a host name that has no dot (a service container, localhost) or no name at all
column4: Refer to Hypatia with the log line and the step: this is a configuration error (the service is not running or is named wrongly), so a re-run cannot fix it
column6: Always a referral: the name that does resolve in the workflow is Hypatia's to confirm

column3: a gate fails closed because it could not read GitHub state: could not read branch rulesets (nothing inspected), could not read the workflow catalogue (enablement is UNKNOWN, not off), or the called workflow could not be read at a SHA (offline with no cache entry, or the API refused)
column4: Re-run the failed job once after the Actions token budget resets, only if that commit is still the head; never edit the gate, its baseline or its allowlist to pass
column5: The re-run reads the state and the gate passes or fails on its real findings
column6: It fails twice on the same commit with the same unread state (a missing permission, not a budget: owner), or the log has a DROPPED CLOSURE line with no could-not-be-read line (a real drop)

column3: a Rust readiness or integration test cannot find its binary under target/debug/build
column4: Use PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_<bin>")); a code fix, first-line only when the code-fix guard passes
column6: The fix would hit the code-fix unsafe list, the code is vendored or third-party, or the check does not pass on the PR head

column3: Validate Hypatia Baseline fails on new code_safety findings
column4: Fix the code behind the finding; never touch .hypatia-baseline.json
column5: The baseline job passes with the baseline file unchanged
column6: The fix would hit the code-fix unsafe list, the code is vendored or third-party, or the check does not pass on the PR head

column3: Sonar S7688, S7679 or S131 in shell scripts
column4: Make the mechanical edit: for S7688 rewrite [ ] to [[ ]] only in files with a bash shebang (never /bin/sh or POSIX scripts); for S131 add a no-op default case *) ;;; decline S1192 in test files, where repetition is a convention
column5: bash -n, shellcheck and the repository's shell tests pass
column6: An S7688 test uses -a or -o or relies on word splitting, the fix would hit the code-fix unsafe list, the code is vendored or third-party, or the check does not pass on the PR head

column3: the DEED job fails could not read Username for https://github.com on a private repository
column4: Root cause: OTP 28 (28.3 and 28.5.0.8) miscompiles Hypatia.Rules.PinSites.walk/4; the template #328 shape only shifts memory layout. The fix is hyperpolymath/hypatia#1062. Never change the workflow to hide it
column5: DEED syntax passes on a private PR
column6: Always, until hypatia#1062 lands

column3: Repo self-tests fails in dismiss-code-scanning-alerts-test.sh with <file>:<line> is not a write permission after lines were added above a permissions: block that .github/code-scanning-dismissals.json keys by line number
column4: Suggest keeping the recorded line where it is: put new comments inline or below it; never re-key the dismissal (it must match the live Scorecard alert's start_line on main)
column6: Always when the permission line itself must move or change (re-keying after Scorecard re-scans main is the owner's call)

column3: an adapter prints a valid findings array but exits other than 0 or 1 and is reported as ran
column4: Accept arrays only for exit 0 or 1 (fleet-report-back.sh translate_or_error)
column6: The fix would hit the code-fix unsafe list, the code is vendored or third-party, or the check does not pass on the PR head

column3: Get Pages site failed: Not Found
column4: Report: Pages is a repository setting; never enable it
column5: The pages job is green or absent
column6: (owner)

column3: a mirror job is enabled and webfactory/ssh-agent fails: the ssh-private-key argument is empty
column4: Report: add the secret or set the enable variable to false
column5: The mirror job passes or is skipped
column6: (owner)

column3: pull_request_target or workflow_run jobs check out or run PR code with secrets or a write token
column4: Report only (security)
column6: (owner)

column3: a push is rejected with GH013: commits must have verified signatures
column4: Report; never amend or force-push someone else's branch
column6: (owner)

column3: a committed data file holds a local absolute path with an account name
column4: Report (privacy)
column6: (owner)

column3: a bot PR shows only external checks and no Actions runs: the workflow-approval state
column4: Report if the PR is meant to auto-merge
column6: (owner)

column3: analyze (actions, none) stays red while GitHub's default code-scanning setup is on
column4: Report: the owner turns default setup off; never work around it in a workflow
column6: (owner)

column3: a workflow ends startup_failure with 0 jobs and no check-runs or annotations while the byte-identical file with the same SHA pins succeeds in rsr-template-repo
column4: Report: the cause is repository-level (Actions policy, allowed-actions list, Pages setting); the owner reads the failed run's banner or Settings > Actions; never rewrite the workflow to chase it
column6: (owner)

column3: gh: Bad credentials (HTTP 401), or git returned error: 401, from a token the workflow uses
column4: Report: the token is invalid, expired or revoked and the owner rotates it. Never retry (a retry cannot succeed) and never swap in another credential. A 403 is not matched here: it can be a rate limit (SQ-RUN-01) or a missing permission (SQ-PERM-01)
column6: (owner)

column3: actions/create-github-app-token fails with Private Key is in OpenSSH format, error:1E08010C:DECODER routines::unsupported, or Invalid keyData
column4: Report: the App private key secret holds a key in the wrong format; the owner generates a new private key for the App and saves the whole file in the RSA PEM form that the App settings page produces (not an OpenSSH key). Never put the key in chat
column6: (owner)

column3: a benchmark gate fails with a ratio over its limit (for example escape_hatches 2.053x, or 2.285x against a 2.0x limit)
column4: Report: a performance regression, or a limit that needs the owner judgement; never raise the limit
column6: (owner)

column3: the same scanner (panic-attack) is pinned at more than one commit across the estate workflows
column4: Report the sites that differ from the ruled pin (owner ruling D7: panic-attack 410a8f82, pons bca1ea28); the change goes through the standards applier, never a hand edit
column6: (owner)

column3: a workflow push is refused by a repository ruleset: gh: Repository rule violations found / Code coverage checks require a pull request. (HTTP 409) (Apodeixis.jl run 43257204071, Publish the lane badges, red on its base too)
column4: Report: a ruleset requires a pull request for that push, so the workflow cannot push to the protected branch. The owner changes the workflow to open a PR or adjusts the ruleset. The squabbler never changes a ruleset and never pushes around one
column6: (owner)

column3: <file>: non-v8 UUID literal (<uuid>) / UUID check failed. Use ESTATE-UUID-V8 (ADR-008) (Apodeixis.jl run 43257204302, ./Project.toml)
column4: Report: an identifier needs the owner or the A7 identity process. The squabbler never mints, rewrites or retypes a UUID
column6: (owner)

column3: SonarQube ERROR Fail to load the list of plugins installed on the server: Not authorized or organization not found, then sonar-scanner failed with exit code 3 (lithoglyph run 43152462261)
column4: Report: the Sonar token or organization is missing or wrong; the owner fixes the secret or the Sonar project. Never remove or skip the Sonar step
column6: (owner)

column3: a workflow force- or mirror-pushes to a forge, gated on a *_MIRROR_ENABLED variable, as Hypatia WF030 defines it (found statically, the definition is Hypatia's and not restated here: standards mirror-reusable.yml gates the job at line 93 and runs git push --force gitlab main at line 144; github-backup-mirror-reusable.yml too)
column4: Report: the owner decides the guard (refuse, or skip loudly, when the source is private and the forge copy is not confirmed private; escalate when the forge visibility cannot be read). The squabbler never edits a mirror workflow, never pushes to a forge and never changes a visibility setting
column6: (owner)

column3: Fork governance failed (deed=cancelled) on a head that a newer commit replaced
column4: Label superseded; read the newest head
column5: The newest head is not deed=cancelled
column6: deed=cancelled on the newest head

column3: couldn't find remote ref refs/pull/<N>/merge and the PR closed before the job started
column4: None: do not re-run a closed PR
column5: The PR API shows the PR closed
column6: The PR is still open (conflict or deleted ref)

column4: None
